description: Implementation of SHA-1 hashing algorithm, including class definition, methods for hashing data, and utility functions.

classes.name: SecureHashAlgorithm
classes.description: Class implementing the SHA-1 hashing algorithm with methods for initialization, updating with data, finalizing, and digest retrieval.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the SHA-1 context, setting initial hash values and resetting counters.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Feeds data into the SHA-1 algorithm for hashing.

methods.name: Final
methods.description: Completes the hashing process, performing padding and processing remaining data.

methods.name: Digest
methods.description: Returns the current message digest as a byte array.
